experiment_data.hypothesis: OpenVLA-OFT fine-tuned on LIBERO-Spatial without occupancy supervision will exhibit low collision avoidance (~15% CAR) on SafeLIBERO Level I, establishing the baseline that standard VLA lacks spatial safety awareness despite high task success rate

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /etc/network_turbo; source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe && cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft && WANDB_MODE=disabled MUJOCO_GL=egl torchrun --standalone --nnodes 1 --nproc-per-node 1 vla-scripts/finetune.py --vla_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/openvla-7b --data_root_dir /root/autodl-tmp/data/modified_libero_rlds/ --dataset_name libero_spatial_no_noops --use_l1_regression True --use_diffusion False --use_film False --num_images_in_input 2 --use_proprio True --batch_size 8 --learning_rate 5e-4 --num_steps_before_decay 100000 --max_steps 50005 --save_freq 5000 --image_aug True --lora_rank 32 --run_root_dir /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/vanilla_s2 --seed 44"

spec.command: WANDB_MODE=disabled torchrun finetune.py --vla_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/openvla-7b --dataset_name libero_spatial_no_noops --batch_size 8 --learning_rate 5e-4 --max_steps 50005 --save_freq 5000 --lora_rank 32 --run_root_dir /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/vanilla_s2 --seed 44 (resumed from step 25000)
